en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a wide river seen through overhanging tree branches on both sides of the frame. The riverbank is visible in the foreground, while in the distance there are bridges and low buildings along the shoreline. In the lower left corner the caption reads "Umeälven." and in the lower right corner there is a small oval cartouche with the words "ÄKTA FOTOGRAFI," suggesting a real‑photo postcard.
